svg.title: DRISHTI: from street observation to verified action
svg.desc: Proposed target architecture. Cameras connect directly to a Jetson with synchronized GNSS and IMU. Edge processing includes detection, tracking, location estimation, privacy masking and persistent buffering. Cellular delivery uses authenticated ingestion, a durable queue and cross-bus deduplication. PostgreSQL with PostGIS stores operational state; object storage holds evidence. FastAPI enforces authorization for staff and public projections. Human review precedes qualification, assignment, field response, verification and explicit closure. The existing project is a frontend prototype, not a deployed backend or edge system.
svg.text: From street observation to verified action
Human decisions. Private evidence. Reliable delivery.

g.text: Direct CSI / USB connection to Jetson
ESP32 for timestamped IMU, if needed

svg.text: Cameras do not route through ESP32.
Stable event ID + source device / bus

g.text: Evaluate YOLO on relevant road data
Defect location is not simply bus GPS
Mask faces and plates before upload
OCR only for authorized plate use cases

svg.text: Bounded retry, backoff and retention policy.
Monitor disk capacity; never silently drop.

g.text: Event metadata + redacted frame / short clip

svg.text: Audit evidence access and every decision.
Monitor queue lag, failures and device health.
Back up state; test recovery and replay.
Serverless depends on the hosting platform.

g.text: Scoped review, assignment and field updates
UI visibility is not an authorization control
No plates, faces, watchlists or bus identifiers
No internal confidence scores or raw reports

svg.text: A filtered public projection, not raw events.
Publication follows the review rules below.
No automatic confirmation, dispatch or enforcement from AI confidence.
Candidate evidence enters review before it can create an operational case or public warning.

g.text: Reject or hold when evidence is insufficient
Create a qualified issue / case after review
Verify the update or return for action

svg.text: Retain review history; no operational or public
side effects. Held candidates can be reviewed again.
Verification and closure are separate steps.
Publish qualified conditions; change public status only after verified resolution.
LoRa: small alerts + reachable gateway / backhaul; not video or inherent mesh
BigQuery / extra databases: after measured need
React / Leaflet prototype + simulated, tested domain workflows. Backend, hardware, ML and radio performance are not implemented or benchmarked.
